svg.title: ASSURED: from learning to genome-editing evidence
svg.desc: Academy offers 12 lessons. Bench combines design, reagent planning, Sanger trace analysis and clone results. Actual bundled MYD88 guide sequences and AB1 channels are shown. Clone 1: dominant -79 bp deletion, 96.3 percent fitted allele share. Clone 3: dominant -77 bp deletion, 50.2 percent fitted allele share. Clone 4: dominant -78 bp deletion, 97.4 percent fitted allele share.
